name: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy towards Upgradation in Transportation through Tracking Devices
benefit:
- A one-time allowance covering 50% of the expenditure incurred for the installation of tracking devices on goods carriers.
- The maximum reimbursement is limited to ₹5,000/- (Indian Rupees 5,000/-) per tracking device, per truck or carrier.

##### ***Disbursal***

- The benefits are subject to a first-come, first-served basis.

_eligibility_text: - The Entity must be only applicable for non-mega industries. - The Entity must own a business unit in Goa and provide Logistics and Warehousing services in Goa. - Support under the scheme shall be provided only to the entities who are Logistics and Warehousing services providers. - The Entity must have a Permanent Account Number (PAN). - The Entity must regularly file the Income Tax Returns in the name of the legal entity (proprietor, firm, or company, etc.). - The Entity must be in continuous operations for a minimum period of six months post the date of notification of Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. - The Entity must have incurred the expenses (for claiming reimbursement) post the date of launch of the Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. - The Entity must not have claimed similar benefit under any other scheme/program of State or Central Government. - The Entity must provide Minimum 40% local employment (employees who are employed continuously during the claim year and are on the payroll of the unit for that year shall be considered). - The Entity or transport operator must possess a fleet and provide cargo transportation services within Goa, whether by land or water. - Transport operators and their commercial vehicles must be registered in one of the Regional Transport Offices (RTO) in Goa and must maintain valid registration credentials. - The tracking device purchases must have been made subsequent to the introduction of the ‘Logistics and Warehousing Policy, 2023’. - The application for reimbursement should only be submitted subsequent to the acquisition of the fleet intended for tracking device installation. ##### ***Preference/Quantum of Benefit*** - The quantum of benefit shall be defined by the proportion of Goan employees on payrolls. - If the Quantum of Goan Employment on payrolls is 60% or above, the Entity is eligible for 100% of the benefits. - If the Quantum of Goan Employment on payrolls is More than 40% but less than 60%, the Entity is eligible for 80% of the benefits. - If the Quantum of Goan Employment on payrolls is Less than 40%, the Entity is Ineligible.
